title: Linkit has a high-risk name collision with adjacent products
evidence: A Bing search for 'Linkit linkitapp.in Hardik Gupta' returned Linkit's own result alongside unrelated Linkit entities including linkit.co, linkitapp.app, linkitdev.com, and linkitnow.in; linkitnow.in is also a creator link-in-bio product. Linkit's Organization JSON-LD identifies the founder and support email but contains no sameAs, alternateName, or geographic/industry disambiguating marker.

suggested_action.summary: Add machine-readable identity links and a distinctive category marker to Linkit's Organization schema.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add sameAs links to the official founder/company profiles, use an alternateName such as 'Linkit by Hardik Gupta' where accurate, and include a clear industry/category and location marker. Use the same wording in the About and Contact pages.

title: Core product and pricing claims have little independent corroboration
evidence: The site claims a link-in-bio platform with portfolio mode, AI visitor chatbot, analytics, storefront tools, and Free Forever pricing. In the live Bing search, independent results included founder LinkedIn posts and a Peerlist founder profile, but no independent result confirmed the full product feature set or the Free Forever pricing claim; the detailed claims remain supported primarily by linkitapp.in itself.

suggested_action.summary: Build independent references for Linkit's identity, feature set, and pricing model.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Secure accurate third-party listings or coverage that name Linkit, its canonical domain, founder, category, and major features. Keep those profiles current and link them from the site's Organization sameAs property.
